name: cp-studio
description: Online editor to write, run and debug C++, Java and Python with test cases and a Gemini AI assistant.
author: Rajveer Sharma

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w server
